subject: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@brightway.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness

Hi Leah —

Great to meet yesterday. Per our conversation I’ve attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that splits the pilot into three phases: discovery, pilot validation, and scale-onramp. Key ask: can you confirm procurement and legal owners for the pilot SOW by next Tuesday (1/26)? That will let us lock the kickoff date.

Highlights in the attached MAP: 
- Phase 0 (Discovery): data access checklist + baseline performance tests — owner: BrightWay (Tom) — target complete by 2/5
- Phase 1 (Pilot Validation): CSV ingestion, API integration, latency SLA smoke tests — owner: Redwood (Marissa) + BrightWay eng — demo week of 2/23
- Phase 2 (Onramp/Scale): autoscaling config, billing cadence, production cutover window — joint owners, target go/no-go 3/19

I’ve also sketched acceptance criteria for each milestone and a lightweight escalation path. Naomi will run the operational runbook and coordinate network/secret handoffs. Marissa will lead integration and validation.

Next steps: 
1) Leah — confirm legal/procurement POC + procurement timeline
2) Tom — confirm which test dataset we can expose (PII filtered)
3) Marissa/Naomi — finalize Redwood tasks and deliverable owners by 1/22

I’ll update the MAP with confirmed owners and send an invite for a short kickoff this coming Monday if procurement is on track.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0192

Attachments: BrightWay_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_BrightWay_draft.pdf
From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@brightway.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsieh <tom.hsieh@brightway.io>
Date: 2026-01-19T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness

Thanks, Sergio — and thanks for the clear breakdown. Quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement/legal POC: I’m the internal lead for the pilot contract, and I’ll loop in procurement if we need standard PO terms. I can sign off on the SOW for pilot spend up to $25k; anything above that will need procurement approval.
- Tom will confirm which test dataset we can expose; he’s aligned on using the filtered telemetry set.
- We need the pilot to avoid long-running KV cache on our side — can you confirm Redwood’s expected KV retention defaults and any config we’ll need?

I’ve penciled availability for a 30-minute kickoff Monday 1/22 at 10:00 PT; if procurement needs time I can move to later in the week.

Leah
Leah Turner | Head of Data Products, BrightWay Analytics
leah.turner@brightway.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@brightway.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-20T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness

Thanks Leah — that procurement cap makes sense and is fine for the pilot scope. On KV retention: Redwood defaults to a short-lived KV cache for pilot profiles (configurable up to 30m) — Naomi, adding you to confirm operational knobs and required network egress rules.

Operational notes / acceptance criteria I added to the MAP (see updated sheet in Drive):
- API integration: 95% of requests return within 350ms p95 for the sample dataset (validation harness attached)
- Data correctness: end-to-end sample pass rate >= 98% for labeled records
- Security: SOC2 evidence for hosted API availability and network controls; encrypted in-transit and at-rest

Owner roster (proposed):
- Redwood integration owner: Marissa Cole (implementation lead)
- Redwood operations/runbook: Naomi Feldman
- BrightWay product lead: Leah Turner
- BrightWay eng lead: Tom Hsieh

If everyone is aligned I’ll create a short JIRA board with three epics (Discovery / Pilot / Onramp) and assign the initial tickets today.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole | Client Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Hsieh <tom.hsieh@brightway.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Turner <leah.turner@brightway.io>
Date: 2026-01-21T13:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness

Quick from eng: we can deliver the filtered telemetry dataset by 2/2. One ask: procurement will likely want a short NDAs addendum and a data processing addendum (DPA) before we share the full sample sets — Leah will lead that. Also, can Redwood provide a small sample token invoice for our finance team to speed PO approval?

Tom
Tom Hsieh | Senior Engineer, BrightWay Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@brightway.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-22T16:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline & onramp: BrightWay pilot -> scale readiness

Looping in finance-friendly artifacts. Leah — I uploaded a one-line pilot invoice template (sample_invoice.xlsx) to the Drive folder and attached a short checklist for PO approval. If procurement wants Redwood to issue an initial invoice at $6k for the sandbox access, we can do that immediately to unblock data sharing.

Summary of confirmed milestones with owners & target dates (I’ve added these to row 2 of the MAP):
- Procurement sign-off (pilot SOW <= $25k): Leah / BrightWay — target 2026-01-26
- Discovery dataset delivered (filtered telemetry): Tom / BrightWay — target 2026-02-02
- Integration smoke tests + baseline perf: Marissa / Redwood — target 2026-02-12
- Pilot validation demo: joint — week of 2026-02-23
- Onramp decision (go/no-go): joint stakeholders — 2026-03-19

Action items for Monday kickoff (1/22 10:00 PT):
1) Lock procurement POC and confirm initial invoice amount
2) Confirm test dataset scope and DPA timeline
3) Review acceptance criteria and JIRA epics (Marissa will share board)

If that looks right I’ll circulate the calendar invite and upload the sample invoice.

—Ben
Ben Carter | RevOps, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: sample_invoice.xlsx, PO_checklist.pdf
